# vis-network

The offline country-network viewer uses the standalone UMD build of
[vis-network 9.1.13](https://www.npmjs.com/package/vis-network/v/9.1.13), obtained
from the official npm package (`standalone/umd/vis-network.min.js`).

The upstream MIT and Apache-2.0 licences are included alongside the bundle.
The report embeds this local asset and does not load the library from a CDN.
